result:
My verdict for DG2 round 14 (re-run) is **PASS** on candidate `sha256:9f3ca298…` (560 files, source `ea9051b2`), with **no new findings**. I had no open finding to verify, so I wrote no `.verifications.json`.

**Candidate check:** HEAD is `e351a34a`, not the source commit. The commits after `ea9051b2` are orchestrator and review-evidence commits that touch none of the 560 manifest files. The recomputed candidate ID matched in the tree, at `ea9051b2` and in both clones, at the start and at the end. Historical DG1 validation passes.

**The three repairs (D-074)**, tested with my own spec in English and Arabic under both locale settings:
- **Session end (FE10, F-DG2-480):**
  - **Sign-out in another tab:** pressing Sign out in a real second tab, then following an in-app link in the first, lands once on sign-in with the translated message. The address stays on `/login`, there is no stale signed-in screen, and Back doesn't loop.
  - **Upload after revocation:** it is refused with 401, nothing is stored (checked in the database), the revocation is audited, and the user lands on sign-in with the message.
  - **Default rate limits:** three tabs ended at once made 1 `/me` request each in about 16 seconds (the original defect was about 130 per second). No 429 appeared, and a second browser from the same IP signed in.
  - **403:** a forbidden read, a forbidden create and a real CSRF refusal all leave the user signed in on the same page.
- **Refused language save (FE11):** the notice appears in the language now shown, English→Arabic and Arabic→English, with the correct `lang` and `dir`.
- **Switching language while an error is visible (FE12):** errors, banners and notices re-render in the new language and direction. The header doesn't grow or squeeze the wordmark at 320, 768 or 1280 px.
- **Negative control:** the same spec run on the pre-repair code fails the FE10, FE11 and FE12 tests, as designed. The 403 tests pass there too, as expected for regression guards.

**Full regression, both locale settings:**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Static checks (typecheck, build, lint, OpenAPI with 161 operations, no-CDN, format, contrast) | all exit 0 |
| Unit tests (Node 22 ×3, Node 24 ×3, plus one run under CPU load) | 7 of 7 runs, 848 tests each |
| Integration on a throwaway database (3 runs per locale setting) | 6 of 6 runs, 652 tests each |
| Migrations | 0001→0019 applied; a second run applies nothing |
| Product e2e | 72 of 72 per setting, including Define→G2 and Design→G3 |
| My acceptance e2e | 164 of 164 per setting; every R8–R13 spec still passes; the `server_encoding UTF8` line is in the log |
| Accessibility (axe) | 0 serious or critical issues over 334 unique scans per setting, error states included |
| Register, pipeline and reconcile validators | PASS |

The three environmental residuals (live registry, live CI, Keycloak) pass on the offline/config surface and remain open as residuals.

**Non-zero exits, all explained in the record:**
- The first dependency install failed because the shared package store is read-only in my sandbox; I retried with a private copy.
- My first migration attempt was missing `NODE_ENV`, which the tool rightly refuses.
- My first development run of the new spec had two bugs in my own test, both fixed.
- The pre-repair control runs failed by design.
- The registry check timed out because the sandbox has no network.

**Observation, not a finding:** if the session ends elsewhere and the user opens a page that makes no request to the server (the static My Work page), the signed-in header stays until their next server request. That follows the repair's rule that a session end is detected on a 401. No data is exposed, and the next request lands on sign-in once.

I wrote no product code. I didn't read the other reviewers' round-14 records before forming this verdict. All clones and scratch files are removed.

Files are in `docs/delivery/`:
- `reviews/DG2/round-14/qa-verifier.json` (validates against the schema; every evidence path exists)
- `reviews/DG2/round-14/qa-verifier.md`
- `test-evidence/DG2/qa/round-14/`
- `test-evidence/DG2/qa/tests/round-14/e2e/dg2-qa-r14.spec.ts`
